meta.title: Dental Implants | The British Dental Hub
meta.description: Restore your smile with premium implant dentistry using digital planning, world-class implant systems and meticulous clinical precision in Cairo.

hero.subtitle: Your treatment starts with a calm clinician-led assessment, clear planning, and a step-by-step pathway designed around long-term comfort and stability.

suitability.title: Is Dental Implant Treatment Right For You?
suitability.description1: Most patients can be assessed for implant treatment with a careful review of their gums, bone support, and long-term restorative goals.
suitability.description2: This section is designed to answer the first questions patients usually have before deciding whether to book a consultation.
suitability.benefitsIntro: You may benefit from dental implants if you...

missingTeeth.title: Missing teeth
missingTeeth.detail: Looking for a fixed, natural-looking replacement.

longTermGoals.title: Long-term replacement goals
longTermGoals.detail: To removable dentures or traditional bridges.

healthyGums.title: Healthy gums
healthyGums.detail: Or happy to complete any recommended gum treatment before implant placement.

boneSupport.title: Adequate bone support
boneSupport.detail: Or suitable for bone grafting following clinical assessment.

generalHealth.title: Good general health
generalHealth.detail: Committed to excellent oral hygiene and regular follow-up care.

stillUnsure.title: Still unsure?
stillUnsure.paragraph1: Many patients who believe implants are not possible are successfully treated after a detailed clinical assessment.
stillUnsure.paragraph2: Every recommendation begins with a comprehensive examination and 3D CBCT planning.

journey.subtitle: From your first consultation to your final restoration, every stage is carefully planned to maximise comfort, precision, and long-term success.

consultation.title: Consultation & Assessment
consultation.description: Comprehensive examination, photos, and CBCT imaging define your treatment pathway.

digitalPlanning.title: Digital Implant Planning
digitalPlanning.description: Implant position is digitally mapped for accuracy, safety, and long-term stability.

placement.title: Implant Placement
placement.description: Implants are placed using precise, minimally invasive techniques for comfort.

healing.title: Healing & Integration
healing.description: The implant bonds with bone while healing is monitored closely.

finalCrown.title: Final Crown & Review
finalCrown.description: Your custom crown is fitted and long-term review care begins.

journey.footnote: Every treatment plan is personalised. Some patients may require additional stages such as bone grafting or sinus augmentation before implant placement.

digitalDentistry.title: Precision Through Technology
digitalDentistry.subtitle: Every stage of implant treatment is enhanced through advanced digital planning, modern imaging and precision-guided clinical protocols.

scanner.label: Digital Intraoral Scanner
scanner.description: Create precise digital impressions for implant planning, restorative design and a more comfortable patient experience.

planning.title: Digital Treatment Planning
planning.description: Each implant pathway is planned digitally to support precision, prosthetic alignment and long-term predictability.

guidedSurgery.title: Guided Implant Surgery
guidedSurgery.description: When clinically indicated, digitally guided placement supports accurate positioning, efficient surgery and minimally invasive treatment.

magnification.title: Magnification Dentistry (Loupes)
magnification.description: Enhanced visual accuracy allows meticulous attention to fine detail throughout assessment, treatment and review.

sterilisation.title: Class B Sterilisation Protocols
sterilisation.description: Strict sterilisation procedures support patient safety and clinical excellence at every appointment.

patientStories.title: What Our Patients Remember
patientStories.subtitle: Beyond clinical excellence, we believe every patient should remember how they were treated, supported and cared for throughout their journey.

featured.quote: The care felt calm, thoughtful and reassuring from the very first consultation. Every step was explained clearly and the experience felt exceptionally well organised.

item1.quote: The consultation was thorough, calm and easy to follow. I left feeling informed rather than overwhelmed.

item2.quote: The clinical care felt precise and personal, and the treatment experience was handled with real attention to detail.

item3.quote: Everything was explained with clarity and patience, which made the whole journey feel reassuring and premium.

consultationCta.title: Ready to Restore Your Smile?
consultationCta.description: Every successful implant treatment begins with a comprehensive consultation. We'll assess your smile, explain every available option and create a personalised treatment plan designed around your clinical needs.
consultationCta.noPressure: No pressure. Just honest clinical advice.
consultationCta.contactNote: Our team will personally contact you to arrange your consultation at a convenient time.
